subject.title: No migration path or warning when a model provider id is removed/renamed (openai-codex -> openai): OAuth profiles silently orphaned

question: Should the remaining narrow fix be an explicit doctor legacy-provider re-auth hint, or should maintainers close this issue once the Nix-mode doctor reachability fix lands because automatic auth-profile migration is considered sufficient?
rationale: Current main already has automatic profile migration and a runtime hint, but the doctor migration warning requested by this issue is still narrower than the reporter expected, and overlapping migration-plan work may change the wording.

options.title: Keep narrow doctor hint
options.body: Keep this issue open until doctor output directly tells users how to verify or refresh canonical OpenAI OAuth after legacy Codex migration.

options.title: Delegate to Nix-mode fix
options.body: Treat the remaining real-world blocker as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/95135 and close this issue after that path is merged and verified.

options.title: Fold into migration-plan PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93180 as the canonical place to settle retained-versus-migrated wording across config, auth, sessions, and docs.

recommendation.title: Keep narrow doctor hint
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until doctor output directly tells users how to verify or refresh canonical OpenAI OAuth after legacy Codex migration.

likelyOwner.reason: Provider unification and the doctor-only legacy OpenAI Codex direction trace most directly to this history.
